Source: http://www.marijuananews.com

Posted March 10, 2000
A bail hearing for Todd McCormick has been delayed again, until March 27.
See
Todd McCormick Being Denied Basic Rights To Medical Treatment -- American Medical Marijuana Association Protests – His Doctor Rebuffed

Sentencing for Peter McWilliams has been delayed until May or June.
See
McCormick and McWilliams Plead Guilty to Avoid Ten Year Minimums.
McCormick Reserves Right To Medical Necessity Defense.
Sentencing Set for February 28.
and
Buckley Denounces Prosecution of McCormick and McWilliams In Strongest Terms Yet.
" On the eve of the trial Judge King decided, so to speak, to eliminate the Bill of Rights. "

Meanwhile in Philadelphia, an appeal of Judge Katz’s summary judgement dismissal of the medical marijuana class action has been delayed as the result of a fire that destroyed the office of attorney Lawrence Eliot Hirsch. The cause of the fire has not been explained to Hirsch’s satisfaction.
See
Counsel For The Class Action Comments On Ruling And Sends Hanukkah Greetings.
" Light and Truth will always vanquish darkness and dishonesty. "
